item.description:
Scriberman 1.0.9

What’s new

  • Updated speech recognition for dictation, live transcription, and saved recordings.
  • Live transcripts wait for speaker labels before finalizing passages, including when recording stops.
  • Replaced speech and speaker models are automatically removed after successful installation to reclaim disk space.

Fixes

  • Avoided unnecessary re-downloads of existing speaker-identification models after upgrading.
